editorial.blurb: Taco Maya brings creative fusion to casual Mexican dining, blending traditional flavors with unexpected Indian-inspired options in a welcoming, well-kept space.
editorial.insiderTip: Hit the salsa bar and try the jalapeño hot salsa to elevate your meal—the complimentary chips and warm salsa are just the start. Order their signature taco with pineapple or go for the Indian-fusion options like chicken tikka or samosa tacos.
